description: Core trip UI: responsive app shell with segmented navigation (mobile bottom tabs + desktop sidebar), warm Tailwind theme + reusable UI primitives, the 'plan at a glance' Dashboard home with countdown + trip-progress, the editable day-by-day itinerary for all 5 days with legs/timings/mileage/per-stop notes and the editable places/stops library, and the car-rental/one-way drop-off panel. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: Create the app shell: src/app/(app)/layout.tsx with a mobile-first bottom tab bar and a desktop sidebar (segments: Dashboard, Itinerary, Map, Group, Money, Logistics, Moments) plus a header with trip title and an editor-unlock control wired to useEditor(). Move the real home into the (app) group.

Define warm theme tokens in src/app/globals.css (Tailwind v4 @theme / CSS variables: warm palette, typography scale) and build src/components/ui/* primitives: Card, Button, Badge, Stat, SectionHeader, EmptyState, EditableField (inline-edit gated by canEdit). Build src/components/nav/* (BottomTabs, Sidebar, EditorUnlock dialog).

Build the Dashboard (src/app/(app)/page.tsx + src/components/dashboard/*): trip summary stats (5 nights, 4 bases, ~1,282 mi, ~21.4 hr, pace note), the route ledger (each night + leg), and src/components/countdown/* live countdown to Dec 27 + a trip-progress indicator. Warm, personal tone (not a dry dashboard).

Build the itinerary: src/app/(app)/itinerary/page.tsx (overview of 5 days) and src/app/(app)/itinerary/[day]/page.tsx (per-day: legs with drive-times + 5:30am starts, mileage, per-stop notes). src/components/itinerary/* and src/components/places/* for the editable per-day places/stops library (add/remove via repository, gated by canEdit; in mock mode mutates mock-store).

Build the car-rental / one-way drop-off panel: src/components/rental/* rendered within Logistics or at src/app/(app)/logistics/rental/page.tsx — editable manual fields (company, pickup/drop, dates, base rate, one-way drop fee, notes) persisted via repository with mock fallback.
Commit locally: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: app shell, dashboard, itinerary, places, rental panel"`.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run dev` serves / and every segment route resolves; nav renders as bottom tabs on narrow viewport and sidebar on wide viewport.
Dashboard shows all seed summary stats and a live countdown to Dec 27.
All 5 itinerary days render with the exact seed mileage and drive-times; adding a stop in mock mode (after editor unlock) appears in the day's list.
Rental panel renders and fields are editable in mock mode.
`npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` all pass with no .env.local.
verification: cd d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build
npm run dev; load http://localhost:3000 and each segment; resize to confirm responsive nav; unlock editor and add a stop
